FINDINGS:
The heart size is normal. There is a right paratracheal density. There are patchy right upper lobe streaky opacities. The remainder of the lungs are clear. There is no pleural effusion.
IMPRESSION:
Patchy opacities in right upper lobe, concerning for pneumonia. Right paratracheal density possibly reactive lymphadenopathy. Followup evaluation to resolution is recommended.
